```python
extra_context['distinct'] = 'DISTINCT' if self.distinct else ''
```

The template is:
```python
template = '%(function)s(%(distinct)s%(expressions)s)'
```

When the filter is applied and the backend doesn't support aggregate filter clause, it uses a Case/When expression which results in `COUNT(DISTINCTCASE WHEN...)` - missing space between DISTINCT and CASE.
